items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault
items.summary: The disgraced entertainer was sentenced on Monday following a four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith accuses him of violence and abuse against her
items.summary: She accuses the disgraced performer of "violence, coercive control and abuse" while the two were together.

items.title: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced
items.summary: The BBC's Sima Kotecha was inside the court as the judge sentenced Brand to 10 years and six months in prison, after being convicted of rape and sexual assault.

items.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
items.summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

items.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
items.summary: Jensen Huang is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

items.title: How a civil servant got away with juggling five jobs for so long
items.summary: Kashim Chowdhury has been convicted of fraud after pocketing £284,000 of taxpayers' money over three years.

items.title: Ground Force and Homes Under the Hammer star Tommy Walsh dies aged 69
items.summary: The building and DIY expert also appeared on TV shows like Challenge Tommy Walsh and Clean It, Fix It.

items.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
items.summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
